sourceTitle: The First White Man of the West Life and Exploits of Col. Dan'l. Boone, the First Settler of Kentucky; Interspersed with Incidents in the Early Annals of the Country.
description: "The First White Man of the West" by Timothy Flint is a historical account written in the mid-19th century. The work chronicles the life and adventures of Colonel Daniel Boone, a key figure in the early settlement of Kentucky and a symbol of American pioneering spirit.
